source.datasheet_title: EFR32MG26 Wireless SoC Family Data Sheet

notes: Figures are the family's headline maximum SKU: 'A Cortex-M33 running up to 78 MHz and up to 3200 kB of flash and 512 kB of RAM'. Smaller-flash SKUs exist in the same family and are not covered by this profile, same convention as efr32mg24.json. dev_kit_aliases: xG26-DK2608A (Silicon Labs' 'EFR32xG26 IoT Dev Kit', board BRD2608A) is the standalone development kit for this family. Fetched via a downloaded copy of Silicon Labs' own PDF, re-extracted directly (154 pp.), not just search-engine paraphrase.
